title: Telecommunications (Amendment) Act 2016 (Commencement) Notification 2017 (S 14/2017)
kind: the text of the Act or notification, from the e-Gazette copy
header_as_printed: 1 S 14/2017 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 13 January 2017 at 5 pm. / No. S 14 / TELECOMMUNICATIONS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016 / (ACT 30 OF 2016) / TELECOMMUNICATIONS (AMENDMENT) ACT 2016 / (COMMENCEMENT) NOTIFICATION 2017 / In exercise of the powers conferred by section 1 of the / Telecommunications (Amendment) Act 2016, the Minister for / Communications and Information makes the following Notification: / 1. This Notification is the Telecommunications (Amendment) / Act 2016 (Commencement) Notification 2017. / 2. The Telecommunications (Amendment) Act 2016 comes into / operation on 1 February 2017.
first_published_line_as_printed: First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 13 January 2017 at 5 pm.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch3.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No search path was used. The text is the output of "pdftotext -layout" on a PDF with a text layer (no OCR), unedited.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/, clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
